title: Volve field Daily Drilling Report DDR-TEST-00071 — wellbore not published in this release
source_system: Equinor Volve / public DDR release — Volve field Daily Drilling
excerpt:
00:00 - 00:45: Pulled 1x stand of DP, m/u BOP cleaning tool. Dropped 2,125in ball to function tool. Sheared at 50bar
00:45 - 02:00: Flushed BOP, made 4x passes across BOP, circulated at 3500l/min, 20bar
02:00 - 06:00: POOH 5,5in DP from 2832 m to 2570 m Had to pump out as excessive fooaming occured in the trip tank. R/u CSG handling equipment.
06:00 - 07:00: R/u CSG handling equipment
07:00 - 07:15: Performed TBT for pulling remaining tubing
07:15 - 07:30: Continued r/u CSG handling equipment
07:30 - 08:45: POOH with tubing from 2570 mmd to 2510 mmd. Cut control lines. Average pulling speed 4 jnts/hr.
08:45 - 09:15: Repaired sensor on casing tong. Meanwhile performed housekeeping on drill floor.
09:15 - 12:00: Continued POOH with tubing from 2510 mmd to 2280 mm. Average pulling speed 7,2 jnts/hr.
12:00 - 12:15: Greased and inspected casing tong
12:15 - 15:30: Continued POOH with tubing from 2280 mmd to 1981 mmd. Average pulling speed 8 jnts/hr
15:30 - 15:45: Pulled out one additional joint and removed control lines in order to have slick joint through BOP while in slips. Meanwhile performed TBT for r/d CSG handling equipment
15:45 - 17:45: R/d CSG handling equipment
17:45 - 18:00: Cleaned and cleared drill floor
18:00 - 18:30: Performed drops check on TDS.
18:30 - 19:00: P/u spear assy from set-back and stabbed into tubing
19:00 - 19:15: Performed TBT prior for engaging spear in tubing and tag TOC
19:15 - 19:30: Engaged spear in 7" tubing
19:30 - 19:45: Removed master bushing and installed PS-21 slips
19:45 - 21:15: RIH with tubing on 5 1/2" DP from 1971 mmd to 2764 mmd. Average running speed 528 m/hr.

22:15 - 22:30: RIH with tubing on 5 1/2" DP from 2764 mmd to 2853 mmd.
